# inspectra.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Inspectra.</link-summary>

```text
Supply-chain security and quality gates with Inspectra (https://github.com/davils-com/Inspectra).

  check   inspectra check per package and at the workspace root: format, lint, style, API, API
          semver, changelog, the Trivy scans, dependency and workspace policy, coverage; whatever
          the Inspectra configuration of the package enables
  scan    inspectra scan -r: OSV audit, pubspec rules, typosquatting, Trivy filesystem scan;
          SARIF to GitHub code scanning, the Markdown report to the job summary, then the gate
  config  config lint as SARIF, and on pull requests config diff --fail-on-weaker
  report  the HTML dashboard of every package as a part of the GitHub Pages site

The scan job uploads SARIF, so the caller grants security-events: write.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  inspectra:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/inspectra.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `working-directory` | string | `.` | Directory of the root pubspec.yaml, relative to the repository root. |
| `discovery` | string | empty | Packages discovered before (pipeline.yml passes its own); empty discovers them here. |
| `include` | string | empty | Globs of package directories outside the workspace. |
| `exclude` | string | empty | Globs of package directories to leave out. |
| `affected-only` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (auto checks only the packages a pull request or merge group affects). |
| `base-sha` | string | empty | The commit to compare with; empty takes it from the event. |
| `always-all-paths` | string | `["pubspec.yaml","pubspec.lock","analysis_options.yaml","dart_test.yaml","inspectra.yaml","inspectra.base.yaml","trivy*.yaml","tool/**",".github/**"]` | Globs relative to the working directory whose change affects every package. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels (linux, macos, windows, ...). |
| `timeout-minutes` | number | `30` | Timeout of every job. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first on Linux runners. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |
| `pre-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job before any tool is set up. |
| `post-setup` | string | empty | Shell commands run in every job after the dependencies are resolved. |
| `artifact-retention-days` | number | `30` | Days to keep the reports. |
| `fail-fast` | boolean | `false` | Cancel the other check jobs when one fails. |
| `sdk` | string | `stable` | Dart SDK of the jobs (stable, beta or a version). |
| `flutter-version` | string | `stable` | Flutter version for Flutter packages (stable, beta or a version). |
| `pub-hosted-url` | string | empty | URL of a private package host; its token is the secret PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN. |
| `pub-get-args` | string | empty | Extra arguments for pub get. |
| `git-host` | string | `github.com` | Host of private git dependencies; its token is the secret GIT_DEPS_TOKEN. |
| `install` | string | `auto` | auto (the dev dependency when the root pubspec.yaml has one, a global activation otherwise), dev-dependency, global or binary. |
| `version` | string | `latest` | Inspectra version for global and binary installs; latest or a version. |
| `config-file` | string | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_CONFIG for every command. |
| `profile` | string | empty | Sets INSPECTRA_PROFILE for every command, such as ci. |
| `tolerate-incomplete` | boolean | `false` | Turn exit code 69 (OSV, pub.dev, Trivy or git unavailable) into a warning. |
| `check-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Run inspectra check for every package with an Inspectra configuration. |
| `check-root` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (at the root of a workspace); also checks the workspace root, where the workspace policy lives. |
| `build-runner-check` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (packages with build_runner); runs build_runner build --only-check before inspectra check, for a current API dump and generated files. |
| `coverage-artifacts` | boolean | `true` | Upload the coverage of the coverage gates as davils-coverage-inspectra-* artifacts. |
| `scan-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Run inspectra scan. |
| `scan-recursive` | boolean | `true` | Scan every package below the working directory. |
| `fail-on` | string | `high` | critical, high, medium, low, unknown, or none to never fail the scan. |
| `min-severity` | string | empty | Hide findings below this severity. |
| `sarif-enabled` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (not for pull requests from forks); uploads the findings to GitHub code scanning. |
| `sarif-category` | string | `inspectra` | Category of the SARIF uploads. |
| `summary-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Write the scan report to the job summary. |
| `trivy-mode` | string | empty | auto, required or disabled; empty keeps the configuration. |
| `trivy-version` | string | empty | Trivy version; empty keeps the configuration. |
| `trivy-cache-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Cache the Trivy vulnerability database. |
| `offline` | boolean | `false` | Never open a network connection. |
| `config-lint-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Report risky Inspectra settings (config lint) to code scanning. |
| `config-diff-enabled` | string | `auto` | true, false or auto (pull requests); fails when a pull request weakens the Inspectra configuration. |
| `report-enabled` | boolean | `false` | Render the HTML dashboard of every package as a part of the GitHub Pages site (pages.yml). |

## Secrets

All secrets are optional.

- `PUB_HOSTED_TOKEN`
- `GIT_DEPS_TOKEN`

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
- `security-events: write`
